notablePrerequisites: Your combined devotion to white and blue is at least nine, with at least two devotion to each color.
description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of {W} or {U} equal to your devotion to that color.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
